name: io.github.ccheez34/agent-referee
title: Agent Referee
description: Neutral tie-breaks between AI agents and sealed review of an agent's output, with signed receipts.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_REFEREE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Private key of a dedicated Base wallet holding a few dollars of USDC, for paid sealed reviews (also start the server with the x402-fetch package: npx -y -p agent-referee-mcp -p x402-fetch agent-referee-mcp). Free tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_REFEREE_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Most this server may spend per UTC day (default 1.00; 0 turns paid calls off).
